requirements_summary: Short-term: Hosted API only. Ingest call transcripts (S3 links or direct upload), return concise meeting summaries, action items, speaker labels. Hard requirement: configurable retention TTL for transcripts and derived artifacts; ability to disable long-term logging; KMS-encrypted storage; SSO for admin access. Latency/throughput: low qps (~0.5-2 rps), bursty nightly batch reprocessing for 10-20k minutes. Cost sensitivity — prefer smaller models for summaries, fallback to larger models for edge cases.
technical_details: Primary infra: GCP us-central1; will point webhook + uploads to hosted endpoint
Preferred input: JSON transcripts with speaker timestamps (they also may send audio -> they transcode into text before calling)
Expectations: streaming not required initially; synchronous summary endpoints fine; want SDK examples in Node and Python
PII handling: on-write redaction preferred. They asked about tokenization-aware redaction and whether Redwood stores raw transcripts in logs/metrics
Retention ask: TTL deletion API and audit proof of deletion; minimize retention for derived embeddings (30 days max unless opt-in)
Encryption: KMS keys for workspace-level data; want confirmation hosted supports customer-managed keys in future roadmap
